India entered this phase with strong macroeconomic fundamentals, maintaining growth at 7.8% despite rising inflation levels. The RBI's goal remains to achieve price stability while ensuring financial market order and health.

articles.title: India brings back duties on specified Chinese titanium dioxide imports
articles.summary: India has reintroduced anti-dumping duties on titanium dioxide imports from China due to material injury caused to domestic producers.
